pista_firmware_kernel_mas_alto.linea: For PS5 Firmware up to 7.61 (23.01-07.61.00) , the (usermode only) bd-jb exploit works and allows some limited native execution. That exploit isn’t a Kernel exploit and doesn’t constitute a Jailbreak, but lets you run some native code on the PS5. Details here .
